profile.headline: Engineering Manager & Senior Engineer | Healthcare Tech | Patient Platforms
profile.summary: Engineering Manager and full-stack engineer with 10+ years of experience, focused on patient-facing healthcare platforms since 2022. Most recently led a 6-person team at VillageMD delivering mobile apps, web, and scheduling systems serving 375k+ monthly users — including a 348k-user authentication migration, HIPAA/SOC2 remediation, and microservices consolidation. Deep expertise in React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS. Open to engineering management, senior IC, and founding engineer roles in healthcare tech and beyond.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area · Remote

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Lead 6-person backend engineering team delivering patient-facing healthcare platforms serving 375k+ monthly users across mobile apps (155k users), web (220k visits), and scheduling systems (77k monthly bookings). Combine hands-on technical leadership with team management, cross-functional coordination, and stakeholder management in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Crisis Leadership & Team Building:
-Rebuilt entire engineering team from scratch after 100% team attrition due to organizational instability while maintaining weekly shipping cadence and reducing production incidents
-Established team processes including sprint planning, code review standards, and on-call rotation using Datadog

Critical Technical Initiatives:
-Led authentication migration for 348,345 users from AWS Cognito to EHR-based system under 30-day hard deadline, achieving 92% reduction in login errors (561/day → 45/day) with zero downtime
-Directed 3-month HIPAA/SOC2 security remediation addressing critical patient data exposure vulnerability, coordinating with external security consultants to achieve compliance certification
-Leading microservices consolidation reducing 18 services to 7, projected to save tens of thousands annually

Cross-Functional Leadership:
-Partner with clinical, product, design, and operations teams to deliver features for Summit + CityMD mobile apps (Android/iOS, 85k users), Village Medical mobile app (70k users), villagemedical.com website (220k visits), and custom patient scheduler
-Coordinate with EHR vendors (Athenahealth) on technical integrations and authentication solutions
-Manage backend services/APIs for patient scheduling, appointment management, and patient communication

Tech Stack: React, React Native, Python, Node.js, GraphQL, AWS, Datadog, HIPAA/SOC2 Compliance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Led the architecture & SDLC of the custom patient scheduler, villagemedical.com website, & UI theme & component library
-Rebuilt the villagemedical.com website theme (HubSpot) - 220k unique monthly visits
-Built new features & maintained the custom patient scheduler (React) - 77k monthly bookings
-Built new features & maintained the VillageMD & CityMD mobile app (React Native) - 155k unique monthly users
-Led projects to build new features supporting patient scheduling (React, JavaScript, Python, HubSpot)

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Collaborated with designers, product managers, and other software engineers to create and ship flexible new features for K Health's 6 million+ users on their mobile and web application.
• Contributed to the improvement of K Health's design system through open discussion, shipping code improvements, and updating K Health's documentation
• Successfully mentored and managed a college intern in application development. In 3 months he built and shipped 3 new features to K's web and mobile apps, including a custom data visualization (far surpassing the rest of his cohort)
• Architected new end to end user testing for K Health's web application
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Contentful · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Healthcare tech · React.js · HTML5 · JavaScript · U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) · Material-UI · Cypress · Web Development · pytest · Python (Programming Language) · SASS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Led the engineering research and development efforts to rebuild and redesign Talent Inc's consumer-facing websites that reach 2.5 million+ visitors/month in the highly competitive career services space
• Collaborated with designers and product managers to design and develop new software architecture to improve user experience, and create a stable frontend feature library for non-technical contributors to use across the Talent ecosystem
• Planned and developed reusable components for Talent Inc's user portal, which services Talent Inc customers as well as customers from 350 international partners
• Mentored junior and non-frontend engineers on frontend principles and technologies
